title: Rotation Engine: A New Era for Subscriptions
summary: Create and manage rotation products with the Rotation Engine, delivering a smooth and efficient experience for customers who love variety with every order.
body_markdown:
Subscription models are the cornerstone of modern brands, providing a consistent revenue stream while driving strong customer loyalty. Retention is the ultimate goal, after all.


If you’ve ever had customers asking for variety with every order, leaving you to frantically curate product lists and make selections each time, you're in good company! Many brands find themselves facing the same struggle.


We’ve been there ourselves—like the time we accidentally sent the same bag of coffee to a customer twice in a row—yikes!


That’s when we knew it was time to revolutionize the subscription game.


### **Introducing** **The** **Rotation Engine**


If you’re looking to transform a list of products into a seamless rotation with automated selections for every order, this is just the thing you need!


Whether you're managing rotations for wet cat food, loose tea varieties, or protein powder flavors, the Rotation Engine streamlines the fulfillment process and keeps customers happy with a consistent variety of products.


### **Features at a Glance**


**Creating the Rotation Product:** Once you’ve compiled a list of products to rotate through, you can create the rotation product in Shopify and add it to your shop.


**Managing the Rotation:** In the rotation product page on Shopify, use the "Manage Rotation" feature to add individual products from your list to the rotation.


**Customizing the Rotation:** Enjoy the flexibility of adding, removing, or reordering products in the rotation at any time.


####


### **Order Fulfillment Made Simple**


We believe engines are meant to run on their own, and the Rotation Engine is no different. Products are automatically selected from the list for every order, allowing you to sit back and relax. No more manual sorting or selecting!


Orders are fulfilled according to the sequence you set, but we’re excited to announce an upcoming feature: an algorithmic fulfillment option that will optimize order selections even further.


### **What’s Ahead?**


At Bottomless, we believe we’re just getting started. With automated rotations now in place, the possibilities for enhancing your subscription business model are endless. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to revolutionize the e-commerce space one day at a time!


Reach out to us athello@bottomless.com to learn how this feature can be part of your store.
